info.description:
## An API for searching current job ads from the Swedish Public Employment Service
**Useful links:**
- [Getting Started](https://gitlab.com/arbetsformedlingen/job-ads/jobsearch-apis/-/blob/main/docs/GettingStartedJobSearchEN.md)
- [Ad fields](https://gitlab.com/arbetsformedlingen/job-ads/jobsearch/jobsearch-api/-/blob/main/docs/AdFields.md)
- [Code examples](https://gitlab.com/arbetsformedlingen/job-ads/getting-started-code-examples/code-examples-start-here)
- [Taxonomy Getting Started](https://arbetsformedlingen.gitlab.io/taxonomy-dev/projects/jobtech-taxonomy/overview.html)
- [Taxonomy Atlas](https://atlas.jobtechdev.se)
- [More open data from Arbetsförmedlingen](https://data.arbetsformedlingen.se/)

parameters.description: Boolean method to use for unclassified freetext words. Defaults to "or"
parameters.name: x-feature-freetext-bool-method

parameters.description: Disables machine learning enriched queries. Freetext becomes traditional freetext query according to the setting of "x-feature-freetext-bool-method"
parameters.name: x-feature-disable-smart-freetext

parameters.description: Enables extra search for the current known term in free text to avoid false negatives
parameters.name: x-feature-enable-false-negative

parameters.description: Fetch job ads published before specified date and time (format YYYY-mm-ddTHH:MM:SS)
parameters.name: published-before

parameters.description: Fetch job ads published after specified date and time. Accepts either datetime (format YYYY-mm-ddTHH:MM:SS) or number of minutes (e.g 60 means published in the last hour)
parameters.name: published-after

parameters.description: True will return all ads with unspecified workplace in Sweden. False does nothing

parameters.description: True will return ads for work outside of Sweden even when searching for places matching Swedish municipality/region/country. False does nothing

parameters.description:
True will return ads which are likely to allow remote work based on phrase matching,

parameters.description:
Sorting.
relevance: relevance (points) (default sorting)
pubdate-desc: published date, descending (newest job ad first)
pubdate-asc: published date, ascending (oldest job ad first)
applydate-desc: last apply date, descending (newest apply date first)
applydate-asc: last apply date, descending (oldest apply date first, few days left for application)
updated: sort by update date (descending)
parameters.name: sort

parameters.description: Show statistics for specified fields (available fields: occupation-name, occupation-group, occupation-field, country, municipality and region)
parameters.name: stats

parameters.description: Maximum number of statistical rows per field
parameters.name: stats.limit

parameters.description: One or more label strings, to filter ads by label
parameters.name: label

parameters.description: An optional fields mask
parameters.name: X-Fields

MaskError.description: When any error occurs on mask

ParseError.description: When a mask can't be parsed
